{"metadata":{"description":"Kiro provider for DeepSeek Harness with Builder ID login, live model discovery, and reasoning effort controls","id":"gh:1345093340","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-kiro","slug":"dat-lequoc/dsh-kiro","topics":["aws","claude","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","kiro","kiro-cli","kiro2api","oauth","opus","reasoning"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Kiro provider for DeepSeek Harness with Builder ID login, live model discovery, and reasoning effort"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ider for DeepSeek Harness with Builder ID login, live model discovery, and reasoning effort controls"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-kiro"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Kiro provider for DeepSeek Harness, with multi-method Kiro login, automatic token/profile refresh, l"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ive account model discovery, Claude/open-weight streaming, tool calls, and reasoning effort controls"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ve account model discovery, Claude/open-weight streaming, tool calls, and reasoning effort controls."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The bundle registers the `kiro` provider route and mounts itself when installed. No API key or manua"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"l `cordis.yml` entry is required."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This is an independent integration and is not affiliated with or endorsed by AWS or Kiro. Kiro and i"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ts logo are Amazon trademarks; see NOTICE.md."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Sign in from **Settings → Kiro** with AWS Builder ID, IAM Identity Center, Google, or GitHub.
- Im"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"port a Kiro refresh token, API key, or CLIProxyAPI-compatible Microsoft external-IdP credential.
- K"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"eep several sign-ins at once — any mix of Builder ID, IAM Identity Center, Google, GitHub, imported "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"tokens, API keys, and external-IdP credentials — and choose the active account from **Settings → Kir"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"o**.
- Sign in with the same methods from a terminal using the included `kiro-login` command.
- Disc"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"over and persist the account's CodeWhisperer profile ARN so refreshed tokens keep the correct profil"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"e.
- Fall back to Kiro IDE/CLI's existing `~/.aws/sso/cache` sign-in when no plugin-managed login ex"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ists.
- Query Kiro's `ListAvailableModels` endpoint so the model picker reflects the signed-in accou"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"nt (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, and available open-weight routes).
- Show the account plan, credit usage, a"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"nd reset date, with a compact persistent model allowlist.
- Keep the quota beside the composer: a ch"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"ip showing what is left of the tightest row, amber under 20% and red under 5%, with the full breakdo"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"wn (plan, used/limit, reset, last read) on hover and a forced refresh on click. It appears only whil"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"e the session's selected model is routed through Kiro, and reads the quota only then.
- Auto-discove"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"r each model's reasoning efforts, including `none`, `xhigh`, and `max` where Kiro offers them.
- Str"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"eam text, reasoning, and tool calls from Kiro's Amazon EventStream protocol.
- Send images to every "},{"id":"p8s16","text":"model whose catalog entry accepts them, which unlocks image attachments and the harness's own image-"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"reading tool.
- Support direct egress or an authenticated HTTP/HTTPS `CONNECT` proxy.
- Hot-reload `"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"llm-kiro` settings without restarting DSH."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### What this plugin does not do"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"It never compacts. As an adapter it owns the provider seam and nothing else: deciding what a convers"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ation should contain belongs to `dsh-compaction-basic`, driven by the token meter and by the overflo"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"w code reported here. So the serializer repairs protocol shape — merging same-role runs, padding an "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"alternation gap, carrying an orphaned tool result as text — but it never drops or condenses content "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"to make a request fit. A conversation larger than the model's window is sent in full, the provider r"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"efuses it, and that refusal is what starts the harness's recovery. Trimming locally would discard tu"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"rns the harness still believes it has, and would hide the overflow that triggers compaction."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The single exception is deliberate and narrow: a text block whose entire content is the legacy `[sys"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"tem: conversation continues]` padding this plugin itself once emitted is dropped when history is reb"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"uilt, because replaying it teaches the model to reproduce it. That invariant is pinned by the "plugi"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"n boundary: the adapter never compacts" tests."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Responses arrive as `vnd.amazon.eventstream` frames. The adapter validates frame boundaries and CRCs"},{"id":"p12s2","text":", routes native `reasoningContentEvent` frames and legacy `<thinking>` runs into DSH reasoning block"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"s, preserves text blocks, decodes tool calls, and suppresses known open-weight prompt-format artifac"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"preserves text blocks, decodes tool calls, and suppresses known open-weight prompt-format artifacts."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The terminal `metadataEvent` supplies the finish reason: `END_TURN`, `TOOL_USE`, `MAX_TOKENS`, `MODE"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"L_CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, `CONTENT_FILTERED`, and `PAUSE_TURN` map to the matching DSH outcome, an"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"d an unrecognized reason fails the turn with a diagnosable code instead of reporting success."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### What a ceiling actually triggers"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The Harness triggers condensation at `min(W × thresholdRatio, W − O − headroom)`
with `W` the report"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ed capacity, `O` the routed model's output reservation
(`maxTokens`, 128,000 on Kiro's Claude models"},{"id":"p15s3","text":") and `headroom` 65,536 by default.
For Kiro that makes the second term the binding one at any windo"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"65,536 by default.
For Kiro that makes the second term the binding one at any window below ~967,000:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| `maxContextWindow` | Condenses at | Verbatim tail kept |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| *(unset)* — 1,000,000 | ~800,000 | ~140,000 |
| 400,000 | ~206,000 | ~44,000 |
| 300,000 | ~106,00"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"0 | ~28,000 |
| 250,000 | ~56,000 | ~20,000 |
| 220,000 | ~26,000 | ~15,000 |
| 205,000 and below | "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"**refused** — see below | — |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Below roughly 205,000 the default headroom leaves no usable message budget, and
the Harness refuses "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"to condense that target proactively (overflow recovery still
works) with a warning naming it. To go "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"lower, lower the Harness setting itself —
this part is `compaction-basic`, not this plugin:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"With `headroomTokens: 32768`, a 200,000 ceiling condenses at ~39,000, and a
250,000 ceiling at ~89,0"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"00. `thresholdRatio` has no effect while the
`W − O − headroom` term is the smaller one."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Per-model overrides exist too, but they match an exact `provider`/`model` pair,
so a Kiro-scoped pol"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"icy has to name every model:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Why some Claude routes need a proxy"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Kiro can authorize model families by request egress as well as account entitlement. From an unauthor"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ized egress a `claude-*` model may fail with `INVALID_MODEL` while open-weight routes work. `proxyUr"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"l` provides the required egress when applicable. The adapter uses an HTTP `CONNECT` tunnel with TLS "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"negotiated inside it, so the proxy sees the target hostname but not the bearer token or request body"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"egotiated inside it, so the proxy sees the target hostname but not the bearer token or request body."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Image content is currently rejected with `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`.
- `temperature`, `topP`, and stop "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"sequences have no accepted placement in Kiro's `generateAssistantResponse` request and are ignored.
"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"- Tool names must match `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$`.
- SOCKS proxies are not supported."}],"truncated":true}
